color.note: Two themes. `idea` is the default graphite Plate; `space-white` is the light projector theme and the ground for anything printed. Graphite neutrals carry the page; `accent` green is rationed. Every gradient surface has a `-ground` stop its text is measured against.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the page (the plate): every Plate page is a gradient from `page-top` to `page-bot` over the first 28rem. Also the header strip top.

tokens.name: page-bot
tokens.usage: The page ground. Paint `body` with it and let the gradient from `page-top` fade into it. Body copy, captions and the title bar read on it.

tokens.name: plate-hi
tokens.usage: The lit top line of the plate: a header strip and the title bar carry it as a 1px inset highlight.

tokens.name: panel-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a raised panel (card, housing, menu, dialog).

tokens.name: panel-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a raised panel. Text on a panel is checked against the darker stop on dark and the darker stop on light, which `panel-ground` names.

tokens.name: panel-ground
tokens.usage: The panel stop its text reads WORST against; set it as `background-color` under the panel gradient.

tokens.name: panel-hi
tokens.usage: One light line inside the top edge of a panel and a lit key.

tokens.name: key-face-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a raised key face (every pressable control).

tokens.name: key-face-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a raised key face.

tokens.name: key-lit-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a LIT key: a toggle that is on, a selected tab or the current pad.

tokens.name: key-lit-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a lit key.

tokens.name: key-pressed-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a key while it is held down: the face sinks, nothing moves.

tokens.name: key-pressed-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a held key.

tokens.name: key-disabled-face
tokens.usage: The flat face of an UNLIT (disabled) key. No gradient, no drop shadow.

tokens.name: key-disabled-edge
tokens.usage: The quieter 1px edge of a disabled key. Decoration only; the word says it is unavailable.

tokens.name: primary-face
tokens.usage: The ONE primary key on a surface: a deep accent face on dark, the accent itself on Space White. Never more than one per view.

tokens.name: primary-hi
tokens.usage: The lit top lip inside a primary key.

tokens.name: primary-glow
tokens.usage: The slight green glow around a primary key on dark. Transparent on Space White, which has no glow.

tokens.name: sel-face
tokens.usage: A selected row or menu item: the same deep accent face as `primary-face`, with `sel-edge` round it.

tokens.name: sel-edge
tokens.usage: The lit 1px edge round a selected row.

tokens.name: well-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a well (text field, dropdown, search): the trough is darkest under its lip.

tokens.name: well-face
tokens.usage: The face of a well from 30% down. Typed text in `plate-ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: well-shade
tokens.usage: The crisp crevice line under a well's top lip.

tokens.name: well-lip
tokens.usage: The light lip OUTSIDE a well's foot, which makes it read as set into the surface.

tokens.name: list-face
tokens.usage: The face of a list well (rubric, grouped rows). Lighter than a field well on Space White so muted text still clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: chip-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a recessed chip (status tag): a shade darker than what it sits in.

tokens.name: chip-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a recessed chip.

tokens.name: chip-ground
tokens.usage: The chip stop its word reads worst against; set as `background-color`.

tokens.name: chip-edge
tokens.usage: A chip's quiet inner edge. Decoration: a chip is never a load-bearing control.

tokens.name: chip-shade
tokens.usage: The soft shadow under a chip's top lip.

tokens.name: chip-lip
tokens.usage: The light lip at a chip's foot, inside and out.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: THE load-bearing boundary: the outer 1px edge of every key, panel and well. Holds 3:1 against `page-bot` and `panel-ground` in both themes, and against `well-face` on IDEA (a key sitting inside a well). Live pair under the floor, kept exact: space-white on `well-face` 2.62:1.

tokens.name: hair-top
tokens.usage: The lit top side of a key's edge (the border is `hair-top` over `hair`). Same as `hair` on Space White.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative divider only. Never the only thing separating two surfaces.

tokens.name: boundary
tokens.usage: The design-system boundary line for a ruled division on the page (3:1 floor). Plate controls use `hair` instead.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rows inside a list well are divided by this line.

tokens.name: groove-dk
tokens.usage: The dark half of an etched groove (under the header strip and the title bar).

tokens.name: groove-lt
tokens.usage: The light half of an etched groove, 1px under `groove-dk`.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: The slanted hazard bars at the two ends of a title bar. Paint only, never a background fill.

tokens.name: body-ink
tokens.usage: Body copy (Rajdhani) on `page-bot`, `page-top`, `panel-ground` and `panel-top`. Warm bone on dark, near-black on Space White.

tokens.name: plate-ink
tokens.usage: Primary Plate ink: chip words, typed text in a well, headings inside panels. Reads on `page-bot`, `panel-ground`, `well-face`, `list-face` and `chip-ground`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: The title bar's ink and secondary words on `page-bot`, `page-top` and `panel-ground`.

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: Mono labels and eyebrows (`label`), the caption under a value, on `page-bot`, `page-top`, `panel-ground` and `chip-ground`.

tokens.name: btn-ink
tokens.usage: Every word on a raised key: on `key-face-top`, `key-face-bot`, `key-lit-top`, `key-lit-bot`, `key-pressed-top` and `key-pressed-bot`.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: The word on a primary key or a selected row, on `primary-face` / `sel-face` only.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: A destructive key keeps the gray key face and takes this ink: on `key-face-top` and `key-face-bot`. The word says what it costs.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: The word on a disabled key, on `key-disabled-face`.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Design-system primary text (the value `plate-ink` takes). On `page-bot`, `panel-ground`, `well-face`.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Design-system secondary text (metadata, hints, the lead paragraph) on `page-bot`, `panel-ground` and `key-face-top`. Words that ARE a key's label use `btn-ink`.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks: scrollbar thumb, placeholder rules, inactive glyphs. NOT body text on IDEA (about 3:1 on dark grounds); on Space White it clears 4.5:1 on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`. Measured: idea on `page-bot` 3.10:1; idea on `panel-ground` 2.79:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: IDEA green, rationed: the selected ring, the lit LED, a link, the one mark that matters on a surface. As text on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`. Never a fill for a large area.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The faint inner accent ring of a lit key.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: The 1px glow inside the broken selection ring and the lit LED core.

tokens.name: hover-ink
tokens.usage: The edge a key, pad or link panel turns on hover: brass on dark, green on Space White. A border (3:1) on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. Solid; holds 3:1 on `page-bot`, `panel-ground` and `key-face-top`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning: as text on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`, always with a word. Space White darkens it into an ink.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Danger and error text on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`, always with a word. On a key use `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Info: metadata eyebrows and the breadcrumb, on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Pinned and highlighted items, the brass hover edge. Text on `page-bot` and `panel-ground`.

tokens.name: status-ok-fill
tokens.usage: Wash behind a success line; its text stays `plate-ink` or `accent`.

tokens.name: status-warn-fill
tokens.usage: Wash behind a warning line; its text stays `plate-ink` or `amber`.

tokens.name: status-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Wash behind an error line; its text stays `plate-ink` or `crimson`.

tokens.name: status-info-fill
tokens.usage: Wash behind an info line; its text stays `plate-ink` or `cyan`.

tokens.name: led-green
tokens.usage: A lit status lamp meaning on, live or new. A lamp is a light, never the only signal: the word beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: led-amber
tokens.usage: Lamp for draft, scheduled or fix. Space White keeps a bright amber because a lamp is a light, not an ink.

tokens.name: led-gold
tokens.usage: Lamp for pinned or a visual change.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit lamp in its cup.

tokens.name: led-off-hi
tokens.usage: The specular dot of an unlit lamp.

tokens.name: led-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px ring round every lamp.

tokens.name: led-halo
tokens.usage: The halo a lit green lamp throws.

tokens.name: led-cup
tokens.usage: The recessed cup a pad's lamp sits in.

tokens.name: led-cup-in
tokens.usage: The cup's deep center.

tokens.name: screen-top
tokens.usage: Top of the readout screen: dark tinted glass in BOTH themes. The one dark island on a Space White page.

tokens.name: screen-bot
tokens.usage: Bottom of the readout screen.

tokens.name: screen-ink
tokens.usage: The glowing readout text and its lamp, on `screen-top` and `screen-bot` only.

tokens.name: screen-glow
tokens.usage: The text-shadow glow on readout text.

tokens.name: screen-rim
tokens.usage: The lit rim along the screen's sides and foot.

tokens.name: screen-shade
tokens.usage: The shadow under the screen's top edge.

tokens.name: screen-wall
tokens.usage: The faint light on the screen's inner side walls.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The diagonal sheen across the screen glass.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The molded 3px frame inside a housing (readout, menu, dialog).

tokens.name: frame-in
tokens.usage: The soft shade inside a housing's frame.

tokens.name: frame-lo
tokens.usage: The shade at a housing's foot.

tokens.name: screw-face
tokens.usage: The face of a housing screw (readout corners only).

tokens.name: screw-dot
tokens.usage: The screw's center.

tokens.name: screw-hi
tokens.usage: The light side of a screw's countersink.

tokens.name: screw-ring
tokens.usage: The dark side of a screw's countersink.

tokens.name: screw-spec
tokens.usage: The specular glint on a screw.

tokens.name: perf
tokens.usage: The perforation dots under a readout screen, fading out inside 60px. The only dot pattern allowed.

tokens.name: brand-plate
tokens.usage: Deep plate green, the largest field in the emblem (28.6% of its pixels). Brand fields in decks and covers; never a UI surface. Bone (`brand-bone`) reads on it.

tokens.name: brand-bone
tokens.usage: Bone, the emblem's letterforms (20.4%). Text on `brand-plate`, `brand-linework` and `brand-plate-mid`.

tokens.name: brand-linework
tokens.usage: Near-black green linework (17.8%): outlines and the darkest brand field.

tokens.name: brand-plate-mid
tokens.usage: Mid plate green (16.7%): the plate's lit face.

tokens.name: brand-sage-steel
tokens.usage: Sage steel (10.1%): the gear. A brand field and rule color, not a text color.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Proof that you can do it alone. Explore the whole kit before you start.
styles.usage: All running copy on screen, in `body-ink`. 16.8px live.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every building, room, toolbox and drawer the shop has catalogued.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph intro under a page title, in `text-2` or `body-ink`.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: A page heading off the Plate (content pages, documents). On a Plate page the title is `plate-title` instead.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading, sentence case, no prefix mark.

styles.name: plate-title
styles.usage: The page title bar, uppercase, centered between hazard ends, in `ink-2`. Live it is clamp(1.05rem, 0.85rem + 0.55vw, 1.35rem): 21.52px at 1440 wide, 0.95rem with 0.06em tracking at 480px and below.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels, uppercase, in `caption` (or `cyan` for a breadcrumb). 11px is the floor for any mono label on screen.

styles.name: button
styles.sample: SIGN IN WITH YOUR SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT
styles.usage: The word on a key, uppercase, in `btn-ink` (0.82rem live).

styles.name: chip-label
styles.usage: The word in a recessed chip, uppercase, in `plate-ink`.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Numbers on the readout screen, uppercase, tabular, in `screen-ink` with its glow (0.8125rem at 480px and below).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Orbitron 900 is for the typed IDEA wordmark only (3.6px tracking at 24px, 17.6px on a phone). Use the logo files wherever an image can go. Never Orbitron for headings, labels or keys.

styles.name: deck-display
styles.usage: The one big statement on a 16:9 slide at 1920 wide, in `body-ink` or `plate-ink`.

styles.name: deck-title
styles.usage: A slide's title bar, uppercase, the deck-scale `plate-title`.

styles.name: deck-body
styles.sample: Hold the part, find the datum, then measure.
styles.usage: Slide body copy. Nothing on a slide is smaller than this except a `label` at 20px.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Measure each hole twice and record both readings.
styles.usage: Printed body copy: 11pt. Print uses `space-white` colors on white paper.

styles.name: print-label
styles.usage: Printed labels and table heads: 9pt, the floor. Nothing printed is ever below 9pt.

spacing.note: The design-system scale in rem. Gaps between controls are `space-2` to `space-3`; panel padding `space-5`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: an icon to its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap inside a control row and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between keys in a row; a well's inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page gutter on a phone; padding inside a compact panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside a panel; the gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The page gutter at 1024px and wider; space above a section label.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between major sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the page footer; a slide's outer margin at 1x.

radius.note: Every control, panel, well and plate is a ROUNDED rectangle. The chamfer is a detail: the selected ring's breaks, the readout screen's lower corners and the title bar's hazard ends.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Chips, small link keys, text inputs and selected menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: The plate itself where it shows an edge.

tokens.name: radius-pad
tokens.usage: Pads: the class tiles and section tabs with a lamp.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Every key and well: a quarter of its 44px height.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-screen-cut
tokens.usage: The readout screen's lower corners, chamfered with corner-shape where the browser supports it.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The theme switch track and LED cups. Not for keys.

shadow.note: Literal Plate shadows per theme. Geometry is identical in both themes; only the colors change, and a bloom Space White does not want is a transparent color.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: A raised key at rest: light ring inside the edge, crisp top highlight, soft foot, a faint tray and a cool drop. Raised means pressable; nothing read-only carries it.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: A key while held: the shadow moves inside at the top and the light moves to its foot. The box never moves.

tokens.name: shadow-key-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary key: a gray bezel, a lit lip and a slight green glow on dark. Space White drops the glow (transparent layers), keeping the geometry.

tokens.name: shadow-key-lit
tokens.usage: A key that is ON (aria-pressed, selected, current). Paired with the broken accent ring drawn in `accent`.

tokens.name: shadow-key-disabled
tokens.usage: An unlit, disabled key: no highlight ring, no drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A raised panel (card, class card, housing): one lit line inside the top, a long soft cool shadow falling down and a little left.

tokens.name: shadow-panel-nested
tokens.usage: A panel inside a panel: the same face with a shorter shadow, so the stack reads as one assembly.

tokens.name: shadow-housing
tokens.usage: A floating housing (menu, dialog, popover, readout): a molded frame inside and a deep drop.

tokens.name: shadow-readout
tokens.usage: The readout housing: a molded rim on every side and a cast shadow. Only the readout carries it.

tokens.name: shadow-screen
tokens.usage: The readout screen set into its housing: shaded under the top edge, lit along its walls and foot.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: A recessed chip: shadow under its top lip, light lip at its foot, NO drop shadow. Inset means read-only.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: A well (text field, dropdown, search): a crevice line under the lip and a light lip outside the foot.

tokens.name: shadow-groove
tokens.usage: The etched groove under the title bar and the header strip.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every student-facing control.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Minimum chip height.

tokens.name: led-size
tokens.usage: A chip's status lamp; 5px clear space either side of it.

tokens.name: hazard-h
tokens.usage: Height of a title bar's hazard block (10px at 480px and below).

tokens.name: measure-reading
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a column of running text.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a single-column page.
